gbm_population_evidence.quote: Histological diagnosis of grade IV glioblastoma (biopsy or partial surgery)

candidate_evidence.quote: addition of AGuIX nanoparticles to standard radiotherapy and concomitant treatment by temozolomide (TMZ)

treatment_setting_evidence.quote: AGuIX Nanoparticles With Radiotherapy Plus Concomitant Temozolomide in the Treatment of Newly Diagnosed Glioblastoma

tumour_pk_planned_evidence.quote: distribution of AGuIX: measure of RMI contrast enhancement in tumor and healthy tissue

role_evidence.quote: to estimate the efficacy of the combination radiochemotherapy + AGuIX (recommended dose), measured by the 6-month progression-free survival rate (PFS) (phase II)

agents.drug_class_hint: polysiloxane gadolinium-chelate nanoparticles (investigational, intravenous); presumed radiosensitiser/MRI contrast

coder_notes: AGuIX is the only investigational agent; temozolomide and radiotherapy are the shared backbone. Tumour PK coded yes on the stated tumour-versus-healthy-tissue distribution measured by MRI contrast enhancement (other PK outcomes are plasma). The control arm is registered as SHAM_COMPARATOR but is standard chemoradiotherapy.
